Fetch a single song by catalog ID

Source: R/songs.R
mk_song.Rd

Fetch a single song by catalog ID

Usage

mk_song(id, storefront = NULL, creds = mk_credentials())

Arguments

id

Catalog song ID (e.g. from mk_search()'s id column).

storefront

Storefront code, e.g. "us". Defaults to creds$storefront.

creds

A credentials list from mk_credentials().

Value

A one-row tibble, same shape as the songs tibble returned by mk_search() (id, name, artist_name, album_name, duration_ms, release_date, genres, url, preview_url). preview_url (a 30-second .m4a clip) feeds mk_play_preview(); it's NA for songs that don't have one.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mk_song("1516773561") # "Molecules" - Aesop Rock
} # }
